tiers.name: important_persistent
tiers.description: Rich personality, memory, relationship graph, routines and ongoing personal history.

tiers.name: persistent_crew
tiers.description: Persistent identity, role, simplified relationships, selected memories and routines.

tiers.name: background_population
tiers.description: Aggregated or low-detail population state until interaction makes an individual relevant.

promotion_rules: C may materialize into B when an individual becomes directly relevant.
B may promote to A when sustained interaction or narrative importance justifies richer simulation.
Promotion must preserve already established identity/history rather than replacing the character.
LOD changes affect simulation detail, not whether the person canonically existed.
principle: A Galaxy-class population can exceed one thousand people without simulating every person's full psychology every tick.
